85401 and 91212 are verified this session by direct read of the served per_skala payload (see per-code notes); 86102 was ALSO PP28-ABSENT at the D0 pull (same family as the 86xxx source_absent cluster) but its final category differs because D5 flagged a payload-shaped problem distinct from the pure crosswalk-absence read (gate §3 item 3). code_collision (1: 90111) — the ORIGINAL D0 hunt's 10 PP28 hits for '90111' were ALL false positives of an ISO-9001 boilerplate matcher trap ('Sistem Manajemen Mutu (ISO 9001)' generic text, not a genuine code match); the truth, image-verified (lampiran 394946 printed p.498, label I.P.8, rows 10 and 12): 2020 codes 90011 AND 90021 (both Rendah/NIB/Bupati-Walikota) are the codes actually on that page — 90111 ITSELF is NOT present anywhere in PP28's lampiran corpus; the near-identical digit strings 90011/90021/90111 are the collision vector (same class as 68112/68111). illegitimate_inheritance (1: 91222) — FIRST BATCH-A SIGHTING of this category (gate §3 item 6): canonical cites parent 91022 (private museums) as source, but 91022's own crosswalk (both directions, p.241 forward + p.437 reverse, seat-cited) goes ONLY to 91212/91300 — NEVER to 91222; 91222's true 2020 lineage is a 2-parent merge {91024, 91029}. Distinct from code_collision (no same-digit trap here) and from mapping_metadata_false (the INHERITANCE itself is illegitimate, not just a label). unresolvable_source_pointer (1: 91424) — the cited row/source (2020-91024) does not itself confirm this code; the gate report does not assert a specific alternate ancestor for 91424 beyond the category assignment (rule #9: no alternate ancestor invented without independent image-verification of this code specifically). The lot's TWO innocence controls (20232 cosmetics manufacturing, 41013 industrial-building construction — the program's FIRST FRESH controls, not reused) are BOTH quarantined for two DIFFERENT reasons that are NOT part of this cure's 13-code detach: 20232 carries a REAL conductor-eye-verified metadata falsity (canonical status_mapping='MATCH_LANGSUNG'/'Direct 1:1 match, scope unchanged' is refuted by two consecutive SPLIT rows on lampiran5_p156-156.png printed p.142 — 2020-20232 splits into 2025-20232 PLUS 2025-20235, with pasta-gigi scope dropped and contact-lens-fluid/bespoke-perfume scope changed); per rule #9 (detach>plausible-remap does NOT license a canonical-cure write from a control finding without the same evidence rigor as an in-scope member, and 20232 is OSS-native with a HEALTHY per_skala that must never be detached — same class as 52101/46100/10433/59140), 20232 gets NO canonical write in this spec: it JOINS the standalone metadata cure-list backlog (with 01629, 71204 from Lot 5 and 59140's pp28-label from Lot 6) as a documented pending item, evidence-gated for a dedicated metadata_only spec+PR later (see the kbli-navigator SKILL.md LIVE STATE update in this same PR). 41013 is a CORRECT fail-closed under the pre-existing contract (its five per_skala tiers genuinely assert fiktif_positif=true with no cited provenance, dossier canonical.json:10/30/56/82/110/140) — the first signing's absolution of it as a mere 'contract artifact' was PREMATURE and cited the wrong legal base (Pasal 230/124(4) for a Menengah Tinggi record instead of Pasal 225(1)); the SECOND SIGNING corrects this and keeps 41013 QUARANTINED, conditional on the contract refinement #2 shipped by THIS SAME PR (infra/workflows/kbli-batch-a-lot.js) being applied and BOTH 41013 seats being re-run under it — that re-run is the validation gate for converting the disposition to 'contract artifact, not record defect', and has NOT been executed by this cure PR (no live Workflow re-run access in this implementer session; flagged as the explicit open item for the conductor).
